description: Human-confirmed links: the packaging purchase order PO5447 case (case.packaging_landed_cost's command, run through python3 -m scripts.eval_human_link_check check), with the console's own review store copied read-only into the check's state directory first (--reviews-from, default PLX_WORKBENCH_STATE_DIR: <dir>/reviews.sqlite, SQLite backup from a mode=ro connection; nothing is written back) so the host build projects the links people confirmed in the console (operator_ui link_confirm panel, POST /api/link-confirm, plx.review accept_link / alias as that signed-in session, review:identity required, reversible by retract). Passes when the landed-cost case answers and the independent oracle agrees. While the oracle still reports a missing link (pi_not_linked_to_po, quote_not_linked_to_po) the command exits 0 and the check is blocked with blocked = confirm_link:<link type> and cause later_ask, and human_link.gaps names the exact confirm step a person must take (decision accept_link, the link type, grant review:identity, where in the console); when the supplier number a document states names no purchase order until a person confirms it, blocked = confirm_supplier_alias. Never auto-creates a link; never writes to Petra systems.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs itconsole's state directory (PLX_WORKBENCH_STATE_DIR) holding a person's confirmed link. Module test is injected-transport: operating/tests/test_human_links.py HumanLinkLiveCheckTests runs this spec's own command in-process over the FakeWorkbench packaging fixture and an injected Graph transport (synthetic zip, synthetic registry), replays it through verify live_verify: blocked on confirm_link:SupplierConfirmation.confirms (later_ask) before a person confirms; a confirm without review:identity is refused; after a granted confirm in the console the check passes with the gap answered. Records counts and enums only, never review authors or review ids.
